yo: Bawo ni, nibo ni o wa?

en: I am happy to meet you
yo: Inu mi dun lati pade e
ig: Obi tọrọ m ụtọ izute gị
ha: Ina farin cikin haduwa da kai

en: For God so loved the world that he gave his only Son.
yo: Nitori Olorun fe aiye to be, o fi Omo re kan soso fun.
ig: Chineke huru uwa n'anya nke ukwuu nke na o nyere otu nwa ya muru.
ha: Domin Allah ya kaunar duniya sosai har ya ba da Dansansa maimaki.
pcm: For God so love the world say e give e only Son.

en: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
yo: Oluwa ni oluso agutan mi; nko ni isina kan.
ig: Onyenwe m bu onye na-azukwa aturu m; ekwesighi m ihe.
ha: Ubangiji ne makiyaya na, ba ni da bukata.
pcm: The Lord na my shepherd; I no go lack noting.

en: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
yo: Mo le se ohun gbogbo nipa Kristi ti o fun mi ni agbara.
ig: M nwere ike ime ihe nile site n'ime Kraist onye na-enye m ike.
ha: Ina iya yin duk abu ta wurin Kirist wanda ya ba ni karfi.
pcm: I fit do everything through Christ whe dey give me power.

en: Trust in the Lord with all your heart.
yo: Gbagbo Oluwa pelu okan re gbogbo.
ig: Tukwasị Onyenwe anyị obi gị niile.
ha: Dogara ga Ubangiji da dukan zuciyarka.
pcm: Trust the Lord with all your heart.

en: Education is the key to success
ig: Mmụta bụ isi ihe na-eme nke ọma
pcm: Education na the key to success

en: Honor your father and your mother.
ig: Sọpụrụ nna gị na nne gị.

en: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.
ig: Egwu Onyenwe anyị bụ mmalite nke amamihe.
ha: Tsoron Ubangiji shi ne farkon hikima.
pcm: The fear of the Lord na the start of wisdom.

yo: Atunwi ni o nmu ni mo daju.
ig: Ime ihe ugboro ugboro na-eme ka ọ zuo oke.
ha: Yawan aikatawa yana sa mutum ya zama gwani.

yo: Ẹ jẹ oninuure si ara yin.
ig: Nwee obiọma n'ebe ibe gị nọ.
ha: Ku kasance masu kirki ga juna.
pcm: Make una dey kind to each other.

en: The sun rises in the east.

ig: Ahụ ike bụ akụ na ụba.

en: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
yo: Ni ibere, Olorun da orun ati aye.
ig: Na mmalite, Chineke kere eluigwe na uwa.
ha: A farko Allah ya halicci sammai da kasa.
pcm: For beginning, God create heaven and earth.

en: For God so loved the world that he gave his only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish but have eternal life.
yo: Nitori Olorun fe aiye to be, o fi Omo re kan soso fun, ki enikeni ti o ba gbagbo ninu u ma ba parun, sugbon ki o ni iye ainipekun.
ig: Nihi na Chineke huru uwa nke ukwuu ruo na o nyere Onye-nwula-ya nwa-nwa-ya, ka onye o bula kwetere na ya ghara inwuta kama o nwurue ndu ebighi ebi.
ha: Domin Allah ya kaunar duniya sosai har ya ba da Dansansa maimaki, domin kowan da ya gaskata da shi kada ya halaka, amma ya sami rai madawwami.

en: Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding.
yo: Gbagbo Oluwa pelu okan re gbogbo, ma si joku lorison oye ara re.

en: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.
yo: Nitori mo maa imoran ti mo ni fun o, ni Oluwa, imoran alafia fun o, ki o ma ba nu, imoran lati fun o ni ireti ati ojo iwaju.
